|strategy=A talented smuggler of goods and information, [[Talon Karrde]] tries too remain a neutral businessman. However, in the early years after the Battle of [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]], he has helped out the New Republic many times. He has provided weapons for Rogue Squadron in their war against the bacta cartel.

A mechanic in his employ, Celina Marniss, has been revealed to be [[Mara Jade]], the &quot;Emperor's Hand.&quot; The two of them have been pressured by [[Grand Admiral Thrawn]] during his attempts to capture [[Luke Skywalker]].

[[Talon Karrde]] is drawn from the Thrawn Trilogy and and [[X-wing]] Series.<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/reflections2/light/small/talonkarrde.html</ref>
